geometry.source: US Census Generalized ACS 2024, 500K county geometry
geometry.method: WGS84 geodesic circles and county-edge distance comparisons.

unresolved.issue: Flatrock property/address reference is supported; exact new hangar/helipad coordinate remains unestablished.

limitations: Approximate public address references are labeled, not surveyed aircraft parking positions.
Aerial imagery can predate recent relocations or new facilities.
Generalized county boundaries are not cadastral surveys.
Adjacent-state inventories remain incomplete during rollout; mapped overlap does not imply availability.
